Welcome to PH Night. The bar is on your left, the dance floor is in the middle, and the exit is behind you. Ask me about work whenever you need a shift.
Serve each guest's requested drink. A wrong drink ends the shift without pay.
Your owned shirts and free character options. Buy more colours at the mainland clothing stall.
Mainland: room west; food/kiosk north; Tunde and parcel south; stock stand east; bus stop north-east.
PH Night Club: south-east doorway. Enter free and use E at the bar to work for ₦1,500.
Community courtyard: south-west gate. Meet Bisi, inspect the garden plan, or rest on the bench.
Sade's shop: north-side provisions doorway. Buy at the counter; work in the stockroom on the right.
Amara's outdoor seating: south-central tables. Buy food, eat from your bag, or take a break.
